release_notes:
Adds **Fastmail custom font** for **Fastmail 4.24.0**.

Select it alongside **Fastmail Catppuccin theme** in Morphe, open its options, and choose a **TTF file**. It can also be used independently of the theme patch.

Adjust size under **Display options → Accessibility → Custom font scale** (70–150%, locally saved). Default (100%) restores normal sizing.

This is the approved test-app version: Macchiato, mauve compose button, custom fonts, and font scaling. The experimental Email spacing control and custom row-layout overrides are excluded. The published bundle excludes the isolated test identity.

Repatch an original APK and keep your existing Morphe signing key.
